## get the two models

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library("nmfspalette")
library(patchwork)

run_SSMSE_dir <- file.path("/testing_cloud")
default <- file.path(run_SSMSE_dir, "default")
default_cv <- file.path(run_SSMSE_dir, "default_lowcv")

res <- readRDS(file = file.path("", "results_multirun_morality_cpuefix.rda"))
summary <- readRDS(file = file.path("", "results_summary_multirun_morality_cpuefix.rda"))
dat_cv <- r4ss::SS_readdat(file.path(default_cv, "red_grouper_1986_2017_RedTideFleet.dat"))

res_cv <- readRDS(file = file.path("", "results_multirun_lowcvrt.rda"))
summary_cv <- readRDS(file = file.path("", "results_summary_multirun_lowcvrt.rda"))
dat <- r4ss::SS_readdat(file.path(default, "red_grouper_1986_2017_RedTideFleet.dat"))

```

```{r}

summary$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_EM_2062", "default_OM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, F_5)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = model_run))

summary_cv$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_redtidecv_EM_2062", "default_redtidecv_OM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, F_5)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = model_run))

test_cv <- summary_cv$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_redtidecv_EM_2062", "default_redtidecv_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

test <- summary$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_EM_2062", "default_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

compare <- waldo::compare(test, test_cv)
compare

test_cv <- summary_cv$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_random_10", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_redtidecv_EM_2062", "default_redtidecv_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

test <- summary$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_random_10", iteration == 1, model_run %in% c("default_EM_2062", "default_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

compare <- waldo::compare(test, test_cv)
compare



test_cv <- summary_cv$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 11, model_run %in% c("default_redtidecv_EM_2062", "default_redtidecv_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

test <- summary$ts %>%
  filter(scenario == "red_tide_regular_3", iteration == 11, model_run %in% c("default_EM_2062", "default_OM")) %>%
  select(F_5)

compare <- waldo::compare(test, test_cv)
compare
```
